narr: A cold front crossed the Susquehanna Valley during the early evening hours of July 9, 2021, accompanied by scattered thunderstorms. There were wind damage reports along the path of a particularly impressive bow echo that developed over eastern Perry County and dropped southeastward across Dauphin, Lancaster and far southwestern Lebanon counties. Further north, a band of heavy rain remained nearly stationary during the afternoon, producing flooding in the Mansfield area of Tioga County.
ev: Flooding with reports of road closures and damage was reported across Richmond, Sullivan and Rutland Townships and in Mansfield Borough. No water rescues were reported. PA-549 was closed near Scouten Road. Sherman and North Academy Streets in Mansfield was closed.
